## Moshpoint: find your mates at gigs 🎸

Tap a mate and a glowing arrow points straight to them. **Android only** for now.

### ⬇️ Install

1. **[Tap here to download Moshpoint](https://github.com/TheZombieRobot/Diet/releases/download/testing/moshpoint.apk)** (about 35 MB).
   Open this page in **Chrome**, not inside Messenger, Instagram or WhatsApp.
2. When it reaches 100%, tap **Open** (or open **Files → Downloads → moshpoint.apk**).
3. If Android asks, tap **Settings** → turn on **Allow from this source** → go back → **Install**.
4. If Play Protect warns you, tap **More details → Install anyway** (it says this for any app not from the Play Store).

Already have an older Moshpoint test build and it says "App not installed"? Uninstall it once, then install again.

### 👋 Add your mate

Ask them to tap **Share Moshpoint with a mate** (or **Send invite**) and send it to you. Copy their whole message, open Moshpoint and tap **Paste invite**. Or scan each other's QR codes.

### ⌚ On your wrist (Wear OS watch)

Got a Galaxy Watch4 or newer, or a Pixel Watch? The watch app points at your mate from your wrist and buzzes you towards them.
**[Download the watch build](https://github.com/TheZombieRobot/Diet/releases/download/testing/moshpoint-watch.apk)** on a computer and follow the [install steps](https://github.com/TheZombieRobot/Diet/blob/ccr-5839ed7c-1q0ztj/docs/WATCH.md#install-on-a-galaxy-watch-wireless-debugging) (about ten minutes, over Wi-Fi). Use it with the phone build from this same page.
